title: Oncology Travel Support — RideLink Daily Meals Rate for Treatment Courses
content:
Members travelling a long distance under Non-Emergency Medical Transportation for radiation or chemotherapy, or who are in a course of outpatient hospital care, receive a higher daily meals rate on their stay.

**Rule.** The daily meals allowance follows the treatment course: when the outbound leg's trip purpose is radiation or chemotherapy and the member has at least 8 paid outpatient hospital claims (the course claim count) with service dates in the last three months, it is the treatment-course meals rate of 31.00 USD; when exactly one of those two holds, it is the treatment meals rate of 28.00 USD; when neither holds, it is the level's standard daily meals allowance.

The claims counted are the member's claims under their Medicaid Managed Care Membership whose service category is outpatient hospital, whose adjudication status is paid, and whose service date falls in the last three months. The trip purpose is the one registered on the trip's outbound leg.

## Condition matrix

| Outbound trip purpose radiation or chemotherapy | 8 or more paid outpatient hospital claims in the last three months | Daily meals allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 31.00 USD |
| Yes | No | 28.00 USD |
| No | Yes | 28.00 USD |
| No | No | Level's standard daily meals allowance |

## Cases

*Hypothetical members:*

- Outbound purpose chemotherapy, 9 paid outpatient hospital claims in the last three months: 31.00 USD a meal day.
- Outbound purpose radiation, 7 such claims: 7 is fewer than 8, so 28.00 USD.
- Outbound purpose dialysis, 8 such claims: dialysis is neither radiation nor chemotherapy, and the claim count holds, so 28.00 USD.
- Outbound purpose dialysis, 3 such claims: the level's standard daily meals allowance.
- A claim that is not in paid status, or whose service date is older than three months, is not counted.
